entries.label: Modern textures — same 16 blocks and order as DevUtils
entries.method: Unmasked 1:1 paste of native 256x256 RGBA cells from the fixed TextureAtlasGenerator export. No resizing, recoloring, compositing mask, or resampling; 1024x1024, 4x4 grid.
entries.notes: Uses the actual atlas3/devutils/icon-proof.json order, not the erroneous STONE/GRANITE/... list in the initial assignment. The parent confirmed that correction. Order: GRASS_BLOCK, DIRT, STONE, COBBLESTONE, OAK_WOOD_PLANKS, OAK_WOOD, OAK_LEAVES, GLASS, SAND, GRAVEL, BRICKS, BOOKSHELF, CRAFTING_TABLE, FURNACE, CHEST, OBSIDIAN. OAK_WOOD (legacy LOG) maps to minecraft:oak_log, not minecraft:oak_wood. All identities have modern equivalents. All 16 saved icon cells and separately saved cells are byte-identical to their source export rectangles; see atlas4/icon-proof.json. Icon SHA256 07d54e88ff01ebf37e0a15da57e811de26c00aa87341fdcef2607fc3b5b6e838.

entries.label: Raw fixed native 256px export used by matching-block icon
entries.method: Unmodified file copy of the surviving examples export, hash-verified against the recorded fixed/config-0 export; JSON copied directly from fixed/config-0.
entries.notes: The original fixed/config-0 PNG is no longer present, but this archived raw copy is identical to its recorded SHA256 c9baa75bac9a498b4d3a5be106ca75163e4d3e33aaa599618f7aba4485cdd681. 8192x12288, 1536 mapped items, all 16 required cells present. No regeneration needed. Exact provenance in atlas4/source-provenance.json.

requestOrderDiscrepancy.resolution: Verified all 16 legacy saved-icon cell hashes against atlas3/devutils/icon-proof.json and used that proof's identities and positions as instructed by Main's correction. The legacy icon itself is unchanged.
requestOrderDiscrepancy.redSand: RED_SAND maps to minecraft:red_sand, but is not in the verified legacy icon and is therefore intentionally not selected.

reproduce.inputs: All input PNGs, metadata, and proof snapshots are preserved inside atlas4. The script reopens the saved icon and each cell PNG and compares decoded RGBA bytes with the raw export.
